core.title: Decorative Screw Covers, Flat or Dome

text.description_html:
First Impressions Decorative Screw Covers

These decorative pieces are used to cover the mounting screw on a door pull. Normally used when installing a glass shower door pull to hide the mounting screw.

They are available with either a "Dome" or "Flat" top and used with a standard 1/4-20 mounting screw. Stock finishes are Polished Chrome or Satin Nickel.

Specifications of FII-SC-DM Dome Screw Cover

  • Diameter: 1"
  • Depth: 3/16"
  • For use with 1/4-20 Screw
  • Material: Brass

Specifications of FII-SC-FL Flat Screw Cover

  • Diameter: 1"
  • Depth: 5/16"
  • For use with 1/4-20 Screw
  • Material: Brass

*Sold Individually.
